items.title: Kenneth Walker: Overshadowed by rookie backup in Week 8 loss
items.text:
Walker carried the ball 21 times for 69 yards and caught four of five targets for 15 yards in Sunday's 28-24 loss to the Broncos.

items.title: Kyle Pitts: Locked down in Week 8
items.text:
Pitts caught two of five targets for six yards during Sunday's 16-0 loss to the Buccaneers.

items.title: Sam LaPorta: Quiet in Week 8 win
items.text:
LaPorta caught three of five targets for 33 yards in Sunday's 19-15 win over the Vikings. He added two rushing yards on one attempt.

items.title: Michael Penix: Nightmare afternoon in rainy conditions
items.text:
Penix completed eight of 24 passes for 125 yards with no touchdowns and four interceptions while rushing five times for 11 yards in the Falcons' 16-0 loss to the Buccaneers on Sunday. He also fumbled once but recovered.
